name: jobboard
description: Rotating job board: a discovery + rotation layer over the quests plugin. Surfaces a devpanel-authored pool of repeatable 'gig' quests in a zone as legal, low-pay early-money work; gigs/take/claim delegate to START_QUEST/TURN_IN. The board is an actionable object (read <board>, clickable Take/Hand-in). OPEN_JOBBOARD lets an NPC read you the postings. Also registers a content-driven greeter move gate (a first-time NPC stops you leaving once), and keeps the lifetime `gigs_completed` player-flag tally that plugins/work gates a shift on.
